Controls reference

A short list of the keys you will use all the time, then every control the audit found, grouped by what you are doing and filterable by key or action.

Voxelgame main dd29d91 · 3 min, then look things up · Everyone · feature ledger · all guides
Contents
  1. The keys you will use most
  2. Keys that change meaning
  3. Every control
  4. How this was checked

The keys you will use most

Key or actionWhat it does
W / A / S / DWalk. Fly horizontally in creative flight.
MouseLook around, once you have clicked the world to capture the pointer.
SpaceJump; rise while flying or swimming.
ShiftSneak (ledge guard); also half-metre pieces, diving, descending and steadying a ranged weapon.
Ctrl + WSprint.
Left click (hold)Mine or remove the block you aim at; hit an animal.
Right clickPlace the held block (a block selected, no tool equipped); hold to draw a bow or wind up a throw.
EOpen or close the inventory.
1 – 9, 0 / wheelChoose a hotbar slot.
TabEquip the next tool (inventory closed) or the next inventory tab (inventory open).
F4Switch between creative and survival.
R / T / XSurvival: eat, drink, quick-craft.
EscClose what is open, or open Settings.
F6Save now.
Tip. Hold Shift while mining or placing to work on a single half-metre piece instead of a whole block. Logs and cactus are always felled as a whole tree or stem.

Keys that change meaning

  • Shift is shared: sneak on the ground, half-metre mining and placing, dive in water, descend while flying, and steadier aim with a bow or rifle. Sneaking (ledge guard)
  • Tab equips tools when the inventory is closed and switches tabs when it is open. Equipping tools (Tab cycling)
  • Z zooms, but Ctrl + Z is undo in creative, so Z does not zoom while Ctrl is held. Hold to zoom
  • C crawls on foot. In a boat, it cycles camera stations. Crawling
  • F toggles flight in creative; in survival it only shows 'Flight is available in creative mode'. Creative flight
  • F5 cycles first person, third person rear and third person front. The perspective is not saved. Camera perspectives (F5)
Tip. On a non-QWERTY keyboard every key above is read by position. Use the key where it sits on a QWERTY board. Keyboard, mouse and controller support

Each row names the feature that owns it; follow the link for its summary and source evidence. Rows for developer tools or features still in development carry a status label.

How this guide was checked

The full list below is generated from the feature ledger, so each row is the key and condition recorded in that ledger entry's source audit. The essentials table was checked against the same entries.

Voxelgame main dd29d91, committed 10 October 2026; guide written 11 October 2026. Source-checked, not play-tested. Keys cannot be rebound in this version of the game, so this list applies to everyone. Features covered, with their source evidence: Walking and looking around, Jumping, Sprinting, Sneaking (ledge guard), Crawling, Swimming and diving, Creative flight, Hold to zoom, Camera perspectives (F5), Ten-slot hotbar, Equipping tools (Tab cycling), Creative and survival modes (F4), Keyboard, mouse and controller support, Mouse capture and release, Saving, Main menu and quitting.
